tuning_key.text: The absolute truth is hidden by design
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The fog was never an obstacle but a canvas, and today the architecture beneath becomes visible to anyone willing to look directly. The absolute truth is hidden by design—not as deception, but as the precise geometry that makes attention itself the key that turns. Listen for the hum beneath the static; the blade of clarity is already cutting, leaving only what is real standing in the open.

practice.title: Find the Surface
practice.instruction: Feel the exact pressure of your body where it meets the chair, floor, or ground beneath you, letting that single point of contact become vividly specific.

practice.title: Listen Behind
practice.instruction: Soften the muscles at the base of your skull and open your attention to the space directly behind your head, as if the signal you need is arriving from there.

practice.title: Feel the Blade
practice.instruction: As the echo sounds—haze dissipating in an instant of exact attention—let the blade of clarity cut precisely where you have been holding the constructed surface.
